name: House of Representatives
notes: 79 seats after the general election of 30 May 2026: Labour 42 (36 won in districts plus 6 corrective gender seats) and Nationalist Party 37 (29 plus 8 corrective seats); no other party won a seat. Totals from published reports of the result (Wikipedia, Poliwave, Robert Schuman Foundation); parlament.mt answers 403 to scripts and the Electoral Commission page shows results by district only, so the totals are not read from the official member list. Later changes (defections, by-elections) were not checked. ADPD holds no seat, so no seat is lit.
